## Vertical scope

- What working behavior changed, and where is the authoritative contract?
- Why is this the smallest safe diff?

## Evidence (exact HEAD)

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run architecture:check`
- [ ] Affected tests identified and run, or explicitly NOT_RUN/BLOCKED
- [ ] Tenant/RLS/private assets/CostGuard checked if impacted
- [ ] GitHub required checks, SonarCloud, Gitleaks, Trivy, Socket reviewed
- [ ] Independent substantive review completed where required by project
- [ ] No unapproved deploy/merge/spend

List evidence links, actual exits and missing proof. A checkmark is not proof by itself.
